query:
update durable_operations set state=$3,last_error_code=$4,result=$5,progress_percent=case when $3='succeeded' then 100 else progress_percent end,
      completed_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_owner=null,lease_expires_at=null,next_attempt_at=null,
      cancel_requested_at=case when $3='cancelled' then coalesce(cancel_requested_at,clock_timestamp()) else cancel_requested_at end
      where tenant_id=$1 and id=$2 and ($3<>'succeeded' or (state='running' and lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()))
